WASDE-452 November 9, 2007
WHEAT:  The U.S. wheat supply and use projections are mostly


WHEAT:  The U.S. wheat supply and use projections are mostly
unchanged this month with imports raised 5 million bushels
reflecting the strong pace of hard red spring wheat shipments
from Canada.  With other categories of use unchanged, ending
stocks for 2007/08 are projected 5 million bushels higher at 312
million.  The projected season-average farm price is narrowed 10
cents on each end of the range to $5.90 to $6.30 per bushel.
